thread:
Maya: tiny follow-up from the autoscale pilot usability session today. I captured a few quick findings and a couple of small layout fixes.

Maya: Observations: 1) new users misinterpreted the burst pill as "free extra GPUs"; 2) pool dropdown placement helped but some missed the helper text; 3) SLO slider label wasn1t visible enough on small screens.

Sam: when you say misinterpreted, did they think burst was permanent?

Maya: yes — about 3 of 8 users thought enabling burst would change their billing baseline. we need clearer copy: `Allow burst capacity (temporary, billed only when used)`. maybe also a small `i` tooltip explaining billing and fallback behavior.

Jorge: good catch. on the backend we already record burst usage, so we can show a post-change confirmation modal that says estimated cost. could also link to billing docs.

Leah: accessibility: a tooltip-only explanation isn't great for keyboard users. ensure the helper text is available inline and the tooltip is supplementary. also the billing confirmation modal must be focus-trapped and restore focus on close.

Aria: suggestion for the billing sentence: "Temporarily exceeds Max; billed only for additional GPUs used during bursts." Keep it short and active voice.

Sam: can we add an inline `Learn more` link to the billing doc that opens in a new tab and has target=_blank plus rel=noopener?

Maya: yes. UX propose: small helper under the `Allow burst capacity` checkbox: "Temporarily exceeds Max; billed only for additional GPUs used during bursts. Learn more."

Leah: also check color contrast for the helper link, especially on dark mode. make sure focus styles are visible.

Jorge: performance note: fetching pool constraints on every picker change added 120ms on mobile due to cold RPC. suggest debounce for mobile and cache last 5 pool responses.

Sam: good call. also we should surface a loading spinner in the pool picker when constraints are being fetched so users don't think their click failed.

Maya: final tiny copy: SLO slider label `SLO (p95 ms)` and under it muted text `Lower = stricter. Recommend quantization or smaller models if breached.`

Aria: one more microcopy tweak: for the inline pool validation callout use: `Selected pool max: 6 GPUs — your Min: 8.` then actions `Adjust to 6` / `Keep 8`. short and scannable.

Leah: accessibility checklist item: ensure the callout buttons are reachable by keyboard and announce action result: e.g., `Min updated to 6 GPUs`. use role=alert for the update.

Maya: next steps: Sam to update mocks with billing helper and spinner; Jorge to debounce + cache constraints; Leah to run a11y pass; Aria to finalize microcopy. I'll post the new mock.

design-bot: updated image: https://redwood-internal.mock/s/autoscale-pilot-fixes.png

Maya: thanks all.
